title: Decision ladder for enterprise billing & credit policy
creator: Aisha R. Patel
description: Purpose: codify a lightweight decision ladder and escalation matrix for customer requests related to pricing, commitments, invoicing adjustments, cost allocation, and marketplace credit reconciliation. Scope: non-bug, customer-facing billing and packaging requests (exceptions, one-off credits, invoice corrections, commitment backfills, marketplace offsets). Out of scope: technical billing system bugs, platform outages, or legal contract negotiation (those route to Legal/Infra).
acceptance_criteria: A single decision ladder PDF available in Confluence with clear thresholds and owners
Triage rubric implemented in Zendesk/CRM: scoring fields + automatic routing to Finance/PM/SE/Revenue Ops
Two sample customer flows documented and validated with Revenue Ops (commitment backfill and marketplace credit reconciliation)
Oncall/finance handoff checklist and invoice idempotency checklist available for ops teams
comments: 2026-03-05 — Aisha R. Patel: Created initial ticket and draft decision ladder after ops sync. Key tension: speed vs. auditability for one-off credits. Proposed auto-approve for < $2k and documented exception path for higher amounts.

2026-03-07 — Diego M. Alvarez: Reviewed draft; requested explicit mapping to accounting ledger codes and how commitments affect reserved capacity billing. Added dependency on ENG-8140 (invoice export changes).

2026-03-09 — Finance (Marta Liu): Added finance constraints — any credit impacting ARR must go through manual approval and be accompanied by a revenue impact memo. Suggested 48-hour SLA for acknowledgement and 7 days for resolution for high-priority cases.

2026-03-11 — Revenue Ops (Jonas Becker): Proposed marketplace credit reconciliation flow: create ‘marketplace-offset’ invoice line, attach purchase order and marketplace ledger id; require monthly batch reconciliation for credits > $10k.

2026-03-12 — Legal (Priya Nair): Flagged that commitment modifications affecting contract terms must include a Legal signoff task and should not be auto-approved. Added to decision ladder as gating condition.

2026-03-13 — PM review (Aisha): Incorporated feedback, added invoice idempotency checklist and sample SQL for chargeback attribution. Ready for engineering review on API changes related to invoice metadata.

2026-03-14 — ENG (Diego): Confirmed ENG-7721 covers prefix metadata on invoices; ENG-8140 will expose ledger mapping. Planning spike to validate idempotency pattern for re-issuing corrected invoices. Blocking: final finance signoff on auto-approve thresholds.
next_steps: Get Finance signoff on auto-approve thresholds by 2026-03-20
ENG to complete spike on invoice idempotency and metadata by 2026-03-24 (ENG-8140)
Publish final ladder and triage fields to Confluence and Zendesk; configure routing rules
Run tabletop scenario review with Revenue Ops and Legal (commitment backfill, marketplace > $10k)
decision_points: Auto-approve threshold: proposed < $2,000 (Finance concern: must not affect ARR without memo)
Commitment backfill: allow back-dated credits only if finance memo + Legal signoff for contract impact
Marketplace offsets: credits applied as separate invoice line with ‘marketplace-offset’ ledger tag and monthly reconciliation for > $10k
Invoice corrections: use idempotent invoice IDs with correction suffix; engineering to add immutable metadata to track adjustments
Cost allocation fixes: apply retroactive tag normalization with discovery window capped at 90 days; >90 days requires manual approval
